method: Manual reading of original trajectories, original requirements and submitted patches. Mechanical indexes only aid reading; they do not assign gap labels.
paused_prior_work: No new pilot, generation or subject execution.
review_requirements: Every trial has its own judgment.
Read the complete public step sequence and inspect relevant code-reading/edit/test events around each proposed gap.
Quote concrete original test setup and assertions; distinguish existing-but-not-run tests from missing tests.
Connect data flow, control/exception flow and dependency/cross-test relations with a specific detection and augmentation implication.
Distinguish direct trajectory evidence from causal hypotheses.
Associate observed outcomes with code version; later production/test edits prevent using earlier passes as final-version proof.
Validation gap alone is not a patch defect.
Unknown is permitted only with the missing evidence and inspection effort stated; no universal no-gap claim.
Do not use old generated tests or known failed hidden cases as substitutes for the original trajectory.

evidence_format.trajectory: step_id + field + verbatim short excerpt + raw file hash
evidence_format.code: path + version step(s) + concrete code/test excerpt
evidence_format.result: command + step_id + observed outcome, without claiming unexecuted assertions
